title: Critical hit
body: A natural 20 on an attack roll hits, and it is a critical hit. Roll the attack damage dice twice. Add modifiers once.

title: Advantage
body: Roll the d20 twice and use the higher result. Disadvantage uses the lower. They cancel if you have both.

title: Death saving throw
body: At 0 hit points, roll a d20 on your turn. 10 or higher is a success. Under 10 is a failure. Three successes stabilise you. Three failures mean death. A 1 counts as two failures. A 20 restores 1 hit point.

title: Help action
body: You can use your action to aid an ally. They gain advantage on the next ability check for that task, if it happens before your next turn.

title: Cover
body: Half cover gives +2 AC and Dexterity saves. Three-quarters cover gives +5. Total cover cannot be targeted directly.
